Department of Artificial Intelligence & Data Science

The people, mascot and team behind CLICK.

CLICK is a learn-to-practice platform built to take a student from an absolute first line of code to genuinely pro-level C -- one tiny chapter at a time. It started as a focused project inside our own Department of Artificial Intelligence & Data Science: pair a short, structured lesson with an instant chapter test, then hand off to real hands-on coding practice in VS Code once the fundamentals actually stick. The goal is to keep growing this into a complete, self-paced path from scratch to professional-level programming.
